title: Very good tour

title: Cadiz
text: Great tour. Beautiful walk along the Atlantic in Cadiz. Wine tasting and history of the Sherry industry very educational. Petra the guide was excellent knowledgeable and friendly and made the day very enjoyable.

title: Extraordinary visit to the south of Andalusia with Carmela
text: Excellent experience and guide. Carmela has great knowledge and enthusiasm. She was super attentive to us and to giving us recommendations throughout the tour. I fear that since there are many places in a short time, a single activity in Jerez is more than enough but of course it remains at the tourist's choice.

title: An exciting travel day to Cadiz
text: We visited a winery for a tour and tasting before arriving in Cádiz where we saw this amazing equestrian show which is a must see. Arriving in the port city of Cadiz was a wealthy and important historically because it controlled the 17th and 18th century trade with the Americas.

title: I recommend
text: Cádiz and Jerez are full of history and wines. The excursion left on time. The bus was very comfortable, clean, and equipped. We especially liked the guide, Ivan, who was very prepared.

title: Andalusian Horses, Sherry tasting , Cadiz
text:
Our goal was to see the Andalusian horses and we enjoyed it. We first had a sherry tasting then the horse show and then off to Cadiz where we had time to have lunch. The Sherry and horses were optional. You had free time if you did nit wish to join them.  Our guide was a young man Luis , the bus comfortable not packed!! 
I would recommend
